channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Jannik Sinner oo la sheegay in qalliin jilibka laga sameynayo, laguna wado inuu seego Australian Open
item.description: Ciyaartoyga tennis-ka Talyaaniga Jannik Sinner, oo ah kaalinta 2-aad ee adduunka, ayaa la sheegay in Talaadada qalliin lagaga sameynayo jilibka midig magaalada Turku ee Finland, taas oo u badan inay ka reebto tartanka Australian Open ee January.

item.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo Addis Ababa ka daah-furtay qorshe Afrika looga hortagayo dhimashada hooyooyinka iyo dhallaanka
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa Isniintii, 23 November 2026, magaalada Addis Ababa ka daah-furtay qorshe qaaradeed oo hage u ah dalalka Afrika si ay u yareeyaan dhimashada laga hortagi karo ee hooyooyinka iyo carruurta dhalashada cusub.

item.title: Manchester United oo racfaan ka qaadanaysa kaarka cas ee Leny Yoro lagu tusay kulanka Liverpool
item.description: Manchester United ayaa Ururka Kubadda Cagta England (FA) u sheegtay inay racfaan ka qaadanayso kaarka cas ee daafaca Leny Yoro lagu tusay daqiiqaddii 8-aad ee kulankii Axadda ay 4-0 uga adkaatay Liverpool garoonka Anfield.

item.title: Enzo Maresca oo ku jawaabay Allegri ka hor kulanka Manchester City iyo Napoli
item.description: Tababaraha Manchester City Enzo Maresca ayaa Isniintii, maalin ka hor kulanka Champions League ee ay Napoli la ciyaarayaan garoonka Etihad, ku jawaabay hadalkii Massimiliano Allegri ee ahaa in kulanku Napoli u yahay mid aad u adag.

item.title: MSF oo 3 bilood u hakisay hawlaheeda Yei kadib afduubka laba shaqaale caafimaad
item.description: Hay'adda caafimaadka ee Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) ayaa shaacisay inay 3 bilood hakisay hawlaheeda agagaarka magaalada Yei ee Koonfur Suudaan, kadib markii rag hubaysan ay afduubeen darawal ka tirsan hay'adda iyo umuliso ka tirsan Wasaaradda Caafimaadka.

item.title: Qoridda Copa del Rey: Valencia oo la ciyaaraysa Real Jaén, Sevilla-na Atlético Paso
item.description: Qoridda wareegga labaad ee koobka Copa del Rey ee Spain, oo Isniintii lagu qabtay xarunta Ciudad del Fútbol ee Las Rozas, ayaa Valencia isugu keentay Real Jaén, halka Sevilla ay la ciyaari doonto Atlético Paso oo ka socota jasiiradda La Palma.

item.title: Axmed Macallin Fiqi: Safarkii Diblomaasiyadeed, Sirdoon, Siyaasad iyo Hoggaaminta Wasaaradaha Soomaaliya
item.description: Warbixin gaar ah oo ku saabsan taariikhda siyaasadeed ee Axmed Macallin Fiqi, laga soo bilaabo safiirnimadii Suudaan iyo hoggaaminta NISA ilaa xilalka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Gaashaandhigga.

item.title: Saadaq Joon oo la sheegay in loo magacaabayo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo xilka laga qaadayo
item.description: Warar siyaasadeed oo soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in Saadaq Cumar Xasan (Saadaq Joon) loo magacaabayo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, halka Axmed Macallin Fiqi xilka laga qaadayo, inkasta oo aan weli la helin war rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaya.

item.title: Abiy Axmed oo sheegay in Itoobiya ay xoojinayso xiriirka Imaaraadka xilli khilaafka Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi uu sii socdo
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed ayaa Isniintii sheegay inuu Addis Ababa kula kulmay Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda ee Imaaraadka Carabta, Sheekh Shakhboot bin Nahyan Al Nahyan, kana wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka labada dal.

item.title: Maxkamadda CAS oo Talaadada go'aan ka gaaraysa cidda ku guulaysatay AFCON 2025: Senegal ama Morocco
item.description: Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) ayaa Isniintii shaacisay inay Talaadada soo saari doonto go'aanka rafcaanka Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Senegal ka qaatay CAF iyo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Morocco, ee ku saabsan koobka Qaramada Afrika 2025.

item.title: Lamine Yamal oo ka maqnaan doona kulanka Barcelona iyo Sabah kadib dhibaato canqowga ah
item.description: Barcelona ayaa Isniintii shaacisay in Lamine Yamal uusan la safri doonin kooxda una ambabaxaysa Baku, kana maqnaan doono kulanka Champions League ee Sabah, sababo la xiriira dhibaato fudud oo canqowga midig ah.

item.title: In ka badan 12,000 oo qof oo laga daadgureeyay hoolka Co-op Live ee Manchester kadib walax aan la aqoon
item.description: Booliiska Greater Manchester ayaa ku dhawaaqay xaalad degdeg ah oo weyn kadib markii walax aan la garanayn lagu sii daayay hoolka Co-op Live xilli bandhig uu qabanayay fanaanka Maraykanka ah Don Toliver, iyadoo in ka badan 12,000 qof laga saaray.

item.title: Swindon Town oo shaqada ka eryay tababare Ian Holloway kadib bilow xun oo xilli ciyaareed
item.description: Kooxda Swindon Town ee League Two ayaa Isniintan shaqada ka eryday tababarihii Ian Holloway, kadib markii ay kaliya laba guul ka gaartay 15-kii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo booqasho hal maalin ah ku tagaya Uganda, xilli hadallada Muhoozi ay muran dhaliyeen
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa booqasho shaqo oo hal maalin ah ku tagaya Uganda si uu ula kulmo Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni, iyadoo ay socoto dhimista ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya.

item.title: AB de Villiers oo sheegay in Australia ay kubadda wax ka beddelaysay tan iyo kulankii ugu horreeyay ee taxanaha 2018
item.description: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee South Africa AB de Villiers ayaa eedeeyay in kooxda cricket-ka Australia ay si sharci darro ah kubadda u beddelaysay laga bilaabo kulankii ugu horreeyay ee taxanihii Test-ka ee 2018, kaas oo dhaliyay fadeexaddii caanka ahayd ee 'sandpaper'.

item.title: Kim Jong Un oo xoojinaya xiriirka dibadda ee Kuuriyada Waqooyi, kadib markii kulankii Trump uu dhici waayay
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi Kim Jong Un ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu uu ballaarin doono xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed isagoo ilaalinaya madax-bannaanidiisa iyo amnigiisa qaran, maalmo kadib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu Aasiya ka ambabaxay isagoon la kulmin.

item.title: Zelensky oo sheegay in Ukraine ay 7 drone badeed ku quusisay markabka dagaalka Ruushka ee Merkury xeebta Libya
item.description: Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa Isniintii sheegay in ciidamada Ukraine ay ka dambeeyeen weerarkii Axaddii lagu qaaday markabka dagaalka Ruushka ee Merkury ee dekedda Benghazi, isagoo sheegay in markabka la quusiyay, markab xamuul ah la garaacay, helikobtar militari ahna la burburiyay.

item.title: Charlotte oo daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay 2-1 kaga adkaatay Chicago Fire ee Lewandowski kulanka koowaad ee play-off-ka MLS
item.description: Charlotte FC ayaa Axaddii 2-1 kaga adkaatay Chicago Fire kulankii koowaad ee wareegga koowaad ee play-off-ka MLS, kadib gool Pep Biel ku dhaliyay daqiiqadda 90+12.

item.title: Fermín López oo laga yaabo inuu seego kulanka Atlético kadib warbixinta garsooraha ee kaarka casaanka
item.description: Garsoore Alejandro Hernández Hernández ayaa warbixintiisa ku xaqiijiyay sababta kaarka casaanka ah ee Fermín López loo tusay kulankii Barcelona iyo Villarreal, waxaana xiddigga Barcelona sugaya ganaax laba ilaa saddex kulan ah oo uu Guddiga Anshaxa go'aan ka gaari doono.

item.title: Sacramento Kings oo la heshiinaya Gabe Vincent si uu u buuxiyo booska 15-aad ee kooxda
item.description: Sacramento Kings ayaa dhammaystiraya heshiis lala gelayo ciyaartoyga xorta ah Gabe Vincent, oo hore uga ciyaaray Lakers iyo Miami Heat, si loo xoojiyo khadka dambe ee kooxda.

item.title: Gukesh iyo Sindarov oo Geneva ku diyaargaroobaya horyaalka chess-ka adduunka ee ugu da'da yar taariikhda
item.description: Horyaalka chess-ka adduunka Gukesh Dommaraju iyo Javokhir Sindarov, oo labaduba 20 jir ah, ayaa Axaddii shir jaraa'id ku qabtay Geneva ka hor tartanka horyaalnimada adduunka, kaas oo noqonaya kii ugu da'da yaraa 140 sano oo taariikhda horyaalkan ah.

item.title: 49ers oo Mexico City 35-10 kaga adkaaday Vikings, Shanahan oo gaaray guushiisii 100-aad
item.description: Kooxda 49ers ee San Francisco ayaa Axaddii garoonka Estadio Banorte ee Mexico City 35-10 kaga adkaaday Minnesota Vikings, waxayna ku sii hoggaaminayaan NFC iyagoo leh 9 guul iyo 1 guuldarro.

item.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo ururrada siyaasadda u kordhiyay muddada diiwaangelinta ilaa 30 November
item.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (NIEBC) ayaa 8 maalmood ku daray muddada ururrada siyaasaddu ku gudbinayaan dukumentiyada diiwaangelinta, taas oo hadda ku egtahay 30 November 2026.

item.title: Nuggets oo waqti dheeraad ah 151-145 kaga adkaaday Bulls, Murray 45 dhibcood iyo Jokic triple-double
item.description: Denver Nuggets ayaa Axaddii United Center ee Chicago 151-145 waqti dheeraad ah kaga adkaaday Chicago Bulls, iyadoo Jamal Murray dhaliyay 45 dhibcood, Nikola Jokic-na sameeyay triple-double-kiisii 202-aad.

item.title: Midowga Afrika iyo Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho ku dhammeeyay shir qorsheyn ah oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka AUSSOM
item.description: Midowga Afrika, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibbada caalamka ayaa Axaddii Muqdisho ku soo gabagabeeyay kulan qorsheyn hawlgal ah oo looga hadlay kala-guurka amniga, ka hor go'aanka Golaha Ammaanka ee Diseembar ka gaari doono waajibaadka AUSSOM.

item.title: Ukraine oo mar labaad afar maalmood gudahood duqeysay kaydka saliidda ee Tatarstan
item.description: Diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Ukraine ayaa Isniintan duqeeyay haamaha kaydka saliidda ee u dhow magaalada Almetyevsk ee gobolka Tatarstan ee Ruushka, waana weerarkii labaad ee aagaas ka dhaca afar maalmood gudahood, sida ay xaqiijisay dowladda gobolka.

item.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo baaritaan madax-bannaan ka dalbatay weerarka markabka Ruushka ee Libya
item.description: Ergada Qaramada Midoobay ee Libya (UNSMIL) ayaa Isniintan ku baaqday baaritaan degdeg ah, madax-bannaan oo hufan oo lagu sameeyo weerarradii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Axaddii lagu qaaday laba markab oo ku sugnaa xeebta Benghazi, oo uu ku jiro markab Ruush ah.

item.title: Cillad software oo dib u dhigtay in ka badan 1,000 duulimaad oo Delta, Jay Clayton oo ka digay cillado kale
item.description: Agaasimaha sirdoonka qaranka Maraykanka Jay Clayton ayaa ka digay in Maraykanku uu la kulmi doono cillado tiknoolajiyadeed oo kale, kadib markii cillad software oo ka dhacday saldhigga Delta Air Lines ee Atlanta ay Axaddii dib u dhigtay in ka badan 1,000 duulimaad.

item.title: Shirka caafimaadka bulshada Afrika ee CPHIA 2026 oo maanta ka furmaya Addis Ababa
item.description: Shirka Caalamiga ah ee Shanaad ee Caafimaadka Bulshada Afrika (CPHIA 2026) ayaa Isniintan, 23 November, ka furmaya magaalada Addis Ababa ee Itoobiya, iyadoo la filayo in ka badan 30,000 oo ergo ah oo ka kala yimid Afrika iyo meelo kale.

item.title: Indonesia: booliiska oo 24 boorso meyd ka soo saaray warshad nacnac oo dab qabsaday
item.description: Booliiska Indonesia ayaa 24 boorso oo meydad ah ka soo saaray warshad nacnac oo ku taal degmada Cikande ee jasiiradda Java kadib dab weyn oo Sabtidii qabsaday, iyadoo tobanaan shaqaale ah weli la la'yahay.
